name: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd.
business_summary: Government of India railway PSU executing infrastructure for Ministry of Railways: doubling, new lines, electrification, metro, workshops, bridges, plus some transmission and sidings (SJVN Buxar siding Rs903 cr LoA, 7 Sep) and a freight-revenue concession. Thin-margin EPC: Q1 FY27 sales Rs4,321 cr, OP Rs185 cr, PAT Rs160 cr; FY26 PAT Rs871 cr (-32%). Stock Rs194, -40% in 12m, near 52-week low. Q2 FY27 not yet reported.

exposures.mechanism: Railways/Ministry of Railways accounts for the large majority of RVNL's order book (company data not retrieved; model knowledge). +10% railway capex -> order inflow +8% -> revenue lags 2-3 yrs; margin ~4% (OP Rs185 cr on Rs4,321 cr, Jun 2026) so earnings are highly geared: +8% revenue at constant margin = +8% PAT; x1.1 EV/MCap x persistence 0.5... + order-flow rerating -> +6.
General central/state capex beyond rail (metro, roads, power transmission, water); partially overlaps P_RAILWAY_CAPEX, so weight set below an independent estimate: +10% capex -> inflows +3% -> +3.

Steel and cement are ~30% of project cost; RVNL's EPC contracts carry price-variation clauses for steel only partially (~60% covered) and the OPM is already ~4%: +7% steel -> costs +2.1% x 40% unrecovered = +0.8% of sales -> EBITDA -20% at 4% OPM; x1.1 x persistence 0.1 (fast fade, repriced bids) -> -2.2, shaded to -1.5. Empirical: none significant.
Interest Rs98 cr/quarter on thin PBT (Rs160 cr PAT Q1 FY27) so +25bp = ~Rs12 cr/yr (-2% PBT); plus P/E 45 duration and high retail/beta (1.7). RBI hiked to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Reuters/The Hindu/Moneycontrol headlines)

exposures.mechanism: Beta to market 1.7 (pack); a +5-point VIX rise historically corresponds to a ~4% market fall and PSU/small-cap beta. Pack empirical t < 1 though; moderate weight.
Retail/domestic-institution-heavy railway PSU theme; +10% monthly SIP/DII inflow -> theme bid.
Road/highway and metro work ~10% of order book (model estimate).
Electrification and signalling cable; price variation covers most; minor. Empirical +0.86 (t +0.6) ignored.
